changelog:
Initial release of the find-law-firm skill.

- Enables search and shortlisting of US B2B law firms by industry, service, location, size, and ratings using the ServiceGraph API.
- Focuses on corporate practice areas: IP, M&A, securities, employment, commercial litigation, compliance, data privacy, real estate, and tax.
- Strictly excludes consumer/personal legal services, non-US firms, individual freelancers, in-house counsel hires, and DIY legal questions.
- Provides clear examples, filter recipes, and API usage instructions.
- Requires API key authentication; detail enrichment has a credits-based cost model.
summary: Use whenever the user wants to find, shortlist, vet, or enrich US B2B law firms — corporate, IP/patent, M&A and securities, employment, commercial litigation...
